Overview

A gel cleanser is the everyday workhorse for skin that tends to feel shiny by midday. Look for mild surfactants and soothing humectants rather than harsh sulfates or heavy fragrance.

It should rinse clean, leave skin comfortable and prepare it for the serum or moisturizer that follows.

Who it is for

Oily, combination and normal skin, or anyone who wants a light morning cleanse.

How to use

  1. Wet your face with lukewarm water.
  2. Massage a coin-sized amount for 30 to 60 seconds.
  3. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry.

What to look for

Glycerin
Humectant that keeps skin comfortable.
Panthenol
Soothing, supports the skin barrier.
Mild surfactants
Cleanse without stripping.

Good to know

  • Light texture, easy to rinse
  • Suits most routines
  • Works for a double cleanse at night

Things to consider

  • May feel too light for very dry skin
  • Fragrance varies by product, so check the label

General information only, not medical advice. Patch test new products and speak with a doctor or dermatologist about skin concerns.
